title: Fix provider.yaml doc URL check with several suspended providers
body:
## Summary

Both suspended-provider filters in the `provider.yaml` check use nested `for` comprehensions. As a result, an entry is kept when **any** suspended provider fails to match it, rather than only when **none** of them match.

When two providers are suspended, each provider's doc URLs survive the filter because the other suspended provider is not present in those URLs. The check then reports those URLs as missing from `provider.yaml`, causing it to fail on documentation that should have been ignored.

The error filter has the same issue and additionally duplicates unrelated errors once per suspended provider.

The cross-product behavior happens to work with a single suspended provider, which is the only configuration the check has previously encountered. With no suspended providers, the nested comprehensions instead produce an empty set/list, which is why the existing guards were needed.

## Change

* Require an entry to match **none** of the suspended providers before keeping it.
* Move both filters to `scripts/in_container/provider_suspension.py` so they can be tested independently.
* Add coverage for zero, one, and multiple suspended providers.

The filters are moved because the check script cannot be imported as a module. Behavior for a single suspended provider remains unchanged.

## Compatibility

Matching remains substring-based, preserving the existing behavior. For example, suspending `apache-airflow-providers-git` also strips `apache-airflow-providers-github` docs, as it does today.

Narrowing the match to the `/docs/<package-name>/` prefix would change the existing matching semantics and is therefore left as a separate change.

+"""Filters that drop what a suspended provider leaves behind in the provider.yaml checks."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from collections.abc import Collection
+
+
+def remove_suspended_doc_urls(doc_urls: Collection[str], suspended_packages: Collection[str]) -> set[str]:
+    """Drop documentation urls that belong to one of the suspended providers."""
+    return {url for url in doc_urls if not any(package in url for package in suspended_packages)}
+
+
+def remove_suspended_import_errors(errors: Collection[str], suspended_packages: Collection[str]) -> list[str]:
+    """Drop import errors raised for the modules of one of the suspended providers."""
+    suspended_modules = {
+        package.replace("apache-", "", 1).replace("-", ".") for package in suspended_packages
+    }
+    return [
+        error
+        for error in errors
+        if not any(f"No module named '{module}'" in error for module in suspended_modules)
+    ]

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import pytest
+from provider_suspension import remove_suspended_doc_urls, remove_suspended_import_errors
+
+BEAM_URL = "/docs/apache-airflow-providers-apache-beam/operators.rst"
+YANDEX_URL = "/docs/apache-airflow-providers-yandex/operators/dataproc.rst"
+GOOGLE_URL = "/docs/apache-airflow-providers-google/operators/bigquery.rst"
+ALL_URLS = [BEAM_URL, YANDEX_URL, GOOGLE_URL]
+
+BEAM_ERROR = "No module named 'airflow.providers.apache.beam'"
+YANDEX_ERROR = "No module named 'airflow.providers.yandex'"
+OTHER_ERROR = "Provider google has an invalid integration"
+ALL_ERRORS = [BEAM_ERROR, YANDEX_ERROR, OTHER_ERROR]
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "suspended_packages, expected",
+    [
+        pytest.param(set(), ALL_URLS, id="none-suspended"),
+        pytest.param({"apache-airflow-providers-apache-beam"}, [YANDEX_URL, GOOGLE_URL], id="one-suspended"),
+        pytest.param(
+            {"apache-airflow-providers-apache-beam", "apache-airflow-providers-yandex"},
+            [GOOGLE_URL],
+            id="several-suspended",
+        ),
+    ],
+)
+def test_remove_suspended_doc_urls(suspended_packages, expected):
+    assert remove_suspended_doc_urls(ALL_URLS, suspended_packages) == set(expected)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "suspended_packages, expected",
+    [
+        pytest.param(set(), ALL_ERRORS, id="none-suspended"),
+        pytest.param(
+            {"apache-airflow-providers-apache-beam"}, [YANDEX_ERROR, OTHER_ERROR], id="one-suspended"
+        ),
+        pytest.param(
+            {"apache-airflow-providers-apache-beam", "apache-airflow-providers-yandex"},
+            [OTHER_ERROR],
+            id="several-suspended",
+        ),
+    ],
+)
+def test_remove_suspended_import_errors(suspended_packages, expected):
+    assert remove_suspended_import_errors(ALL_ERRORS, suspended_packages) == expected
